text: I make haste: Heb. my haste is in me
His children shall seek to please the poor: Or, the poor shall oppress his children
within his mouth: Heb. in the midst of his palate
the floods, the brooks: Or, streaming brooks
according to his substance shall the restitution be: Heb. according to the substance of his exchange
There shall none of his meat be left: Or, there shall be none left for his meats
appointed unto him by God: Heb. of his decree from God
